question: Should stored extended-stable package installs join the default checkOnStart startup and 24-hour read-only update hint path?
rationale: Current main and prior docs deliberately make extended-stable foreground/on-demand only, while this PR changes the behavior of an existing persisted update.channel value under a protected maintainer label.

options.title: Accept Read-Only Hints
options.body: Merge the direction once maintainers accept the new default and exact-head validation is green, because the implementation keeps automatic apply, handoff, restart, stable jitter, and beta polling out of extended-stable.

options.title: Keep Foreground-Only
options.body: Pause or close this PR if the intended contract is that extended-stable availability is discovered only through explicit update/status commands.

options.title: Require Opt-In Policy
options.body: Ask for a narrower opt-in setting or release-channel policy before changing startup behavior for stored extended-stable selections.

recommendation.title: Accept Read-Only Hints
recommendation.body: Merge the direction once maintainers accept the new default and exact-head validation is green, because the implementation keeps automatic apply, handoff, restart, stable jitter, and beta polling out of extended-stable.

likelyOwner.reason: kevinslin owns the recent merged extended-stable channel implementation and authored this follow-up behavior change.
